'''Kumata Shrine''' (杭全神社, ''Kumata Jinja'') is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in Hirano-miyamachi, Hirano-ku, Osaka. It was originally a {{ill|Kumano Gongen|ja|熊野権現|qid=Q3200355}} Shrine dedicated to the {{ill|Kumano Gongen|ja|熊野権現|simple|Kumano Gongen|zh|熊野權現|qid=Q11568925}}. Its former {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|en|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|qid=Q712534}} was Prefectural Shrine. It is worshipped as the clan shrine (ujigami) of the {{ill|Sakanoue clan|ja|坂上氏|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10928477}} and of {{ill|Hirano|ja|平野郷|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 平野 (大阪市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11483598}}. The summer festival (Hirano Danjiri Festival) is held annually from July 11 to 14, restricting traffic on nearby {{ill|Japan National Route 25|en|Japan National Route 25|qid=Q900338|lt=National Route 25}}.

== History ==
{{ill|Zhenguan|en|Zhenguan|qid=Q3577278|lt=Jōgan}} 4 ({{ill|862|en|862|qid=Q24993|lt=862}}), {{ill|Sakanoue no Tamuramaro|en|Sakanoue no Tamuramaro|qid=Q941979|lt=Sakanoue no Tamuramaro}}'s grandson {{ill|Sakanoue no Tōdō|ja|坂上当道|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11424789}} established the shrine to {{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}} (Susanoo-no-Mikoto) which became the First Main Hall.

== Worshipped deities (Saijin) ==
{{see also|{{ill|Saijin|ja|祭神|qid=Q11591100}}}}
Main deities worshipped:
* First Main Hall - {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素盞嗚尊|qid=Q272993}} ({{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}})
* Second Main Hall - {{ill|Izanami|ja|伊弉册尊|qid=Q682306|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q682306}}, {{ill|Kumano Gongen|ja|速玉男尊|lt=Hayatama-no-Mikoto|qid=Q3200355}}, {{ill|Kumano Gongen|ja|熊野権現|simple|Kumano Gongen|zh|熊野權現|qid=Q11568925}} ({{ill|Kumano Gongen|ja|熊野権現|simple|Kumano Gongen|zh|熊野權現|qid=Q11568925}})
* Third Main Hall - {{ill|Izanagi|ja|伊弉諾尊|qid=Q813858|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q813858}} ({{ill|Kumano Shōjō Gongen|ja|熊野證誠権現|qid=Q140446056}})
